title: Still Looking for Testers for our Image to 3d AI!
author: Your-Vision
selftext:
Hey everyone,

Sharing a new test render from a personal project we’re experimenting with AI to turn images into 3D models, and this was made using our own pipeline.

I’d love to hear your thoughts on the output quality.  Also happy to answer questions about the process or workflow.

comments.author: TWSolar
comments.body: I'd be curious to try! Is it capable of making buildings with on/off States?

replies.author: Your-Vision
replies.body: At the moment we are taking in all suggestions we are getting if you would like to see more about what we are doing you could join our discord [https://discord.gg/cukY5W4Q](https://discord.gg/cukY5W4Q) thanks!!

comments.author: RelapseCatAddict
comments.body: This image is very dark but I am interested in seeing the workflow and how you make it work. Looks promising.

replies.author: Your-Vision
replies.body: We are working developing tutorials at the moment but in the meantime if you would like you could join our discord [https://discord.gg/cukY5W4Q](https://discord.gg/cukY5W4Q) thanks!

comments.body: the image is too dark, do you need support on 3d ai models？ i am working on it

replies.body: Awesome we are working on beginning testing here very shortly once we are ready we will send it out to our discord members our discord is here: [https://discord.gg/cukY5W4Q](https://discord.gg/cukY5W4Q) thanks!!
